confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price checks. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable for a Thai beach town. Accommodation is less certain and July is monsoon low season on the Andaman coast, so rates may be lower than peak-season listings. Cocktail and wine are bounded using the beer relationship because direct knowledge of Krabi bar prices is weak. The FX value was taken from a search-result summary of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page, which I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Thailand's Andaman coast tourist towns (Phuket, Ao Nang, Koh Samui), adjusted downward for Krabi's generally lower hotel and restaurant prices and the July monsoon season.
